title: Baby swing with mosquito net, great for naps
text: Electric baby swing / rocker, white and gray, comes with net and remote. My son napped in it every day. Model BB501. Smoke-free home.

title: Braided crib bumper, gray, like new
text: Soft braided bumper that ties around the crib. Keeps little arms and legs from getting stuck in the slats. Washed, like new.

title: Fisher-Price Snugabunny cradle 'n swing
text: Cradle swing with the cute bunny headrest and insert, all music and motion settings work. Model V0099. Pick up only.

title: Solid wood crib, side drops down for easy access
text: Older crib but sturdy. The front side slides down so it's easy to lift baby out. Mattress not included.

title: Bumbo floor seat with safety belt
text: Bumbo seat in good shape, has the restraint belt installed. Great for sitting practice on the floor.

title: Evenflo convertible car seat
